name: Ingrid Lindgren
action: Ingrid sets her tea down, picks up her phone, and places the order for the third-floor bathroom hand soap before the front desk opens.
reason: Ingrid is tired, but she sees the soap refill as the kind of thing that could turn into a complaint if she leaves it. The memory of the empty dispenser in suite 7 and the irritation of having to apologize for it make her not want another apology over something she should already have fixed. Because her mother is calm, she feels able to use the few minutes properly and get the order done.
